# SpikeTimingDependentOptimization

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An optimization framework that leverages the precise timing of spikes to encode and update constraint satisfaction states, rather than rate-based coding. Exploits temporal dynamics of spiking neurons for faster and more efficient constraint propagation in neuromorphic hardware.
